xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4295: Fly remote: restore auto-reap, heartbeat and credential refresh; stop copying SSH keys to VMs

plan.title: Fly remote: restore auto-reap, heartbeat and credential refresh; stop copying SSH keys to VMs
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The Cut (PAN-3917, commit 94255f055fe) dropped the three host loops for Fly remote agents: auto-reap, the ephemeral-VM host heartbeat and the Claude credential refresh (whose function was later deleted as dead code in 441e2ef5078). A finished remote agent now sits on a running machine until the operator runs pan admin remote reap; ephemeral VMs never self-stop because no host writes /workspace/.pan/host-heartbeat; long runs stall on 401. The reap also no longer starts review (its completed-marker consumer was deleted) and is unsafe to automate (a failed exec reads as a dead session; it scans starting agents mid-spawn). Separately, pan workspace create --remote copies ~/.ssh/id_* and ~/.overdeck/ssh/exe-dev-key to the VM, in a creator that is broken on the current image anyway.
narratives.Proposal: Restore the credential refresh into src/lib/remote/remote-credential-refresh.ts; run it and the existing heartbeat every 60 s in hygiene-scheduler.ts (not behind the deacon freeze). Make the one reap function classify from positive evidence (Fly machine state + tri-state exec probes; new 'indeterminate' result), skip starting agents, and request review through requestReviewThroughRoute with a new 'remote-reap' source after deleting the remote workspace metadata. Run it as deacon-lite's last routine through remote-reap-routine.ts with an in-flight guard. Delete the CLI duplicate remote-workspace creator so pan workspace create --remote uses src/lib/remote-workspace.ts (HTTPS clone with the gh credential helper, no SSH key). Document the loops, then run an operator-consented live smoke test of pan start --remote.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Running pan serve on the VM or linking it at spawn (W-FLY2, #4652); Codex on Fly (W-FLY3, #4296)
- Remote agents as session rows or live transcripts (PAN-1775); overflow scheduling (PAN-1676)
- GitLab-hosted or polyrepo projects on Fly (no glab in the image; polyrepo only existed in the deleted broken creator)
- A second reap path: the automatic loop and pan admin remote reap call the same reapCompletedRemoteAgents()
- A new stored status record or revived patrol framework (no firing budgets, no patrol heartbeat file)
- Reconciling remote-state.json for a machine destroyed outside Overdeck (it stays indeterminate)
- A cross-process lock between the automatic reap and a concurrent manual pan admin remote reap
- Settling remote transcripts into the Session Vault (PAN-2609 WI-9)
- Fixing smoke-test failures outside this issue's code; those are filed as new issues
- Copying any SSH private key to a VM by any path
- Running pan reload or pan restart from the work agent (the Flywheel deploys; the automatic tick is confirmed by a filed post-merge check)

metadata.sizeJustification: Three loops and the reap hand-off share one remote-agent contract and must ship together for the W-FLY1 Done-when; files stay under 25.

autoDecisions.summary: Heartbeat and credential refresh run in hygiene-scheduler.ts; the reap runs in deacon-lite.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: Hygiene routines run under the deacon freeze; a frozen deacon that stopped heartbeats would let every ephemeral watchdog stop its machine within 5 min. The reap writes agent state and requests review, so the freeze must stop it. Both modules are the post-Cut runtime the issue names.

autoDecisions.summary: The reap gains positive-evidence classification and skips starting agents
autoDecisions.rationale: Running the reap automatically every 60 s turns one Fly API blip or a mid-spawn tick into a stopped healthy machine; the issue's constraint is to derive from the sentinel and the machine state Fly reports, which needs a distinguishable failed probe.

autoDecisions.summary: The reap requests review via requestReviewThroughRoute with a new 'remote-reap' source
autoDecisions.rationale: Post-Cut review starts from POST /api/review/:id/request (what pan done calls); the completed marker's consumer was deleted, so the issue's 'hand-off to review' does not happen without this. A distinct source keeps the journal honest for manual and automatic reaps.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete the CLI duplicate remote-workspace creator instead of patching its key copy
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the only key-copy site and is already broken (clones to ~/workspace, sudo ln with no sudo in the image); the lib creator is what pan start --remote uses. One creator matches 'one variant per operation'.
It is also a private key that opens the operator's repos; D-12's intent is that the VM holds no operator SSH key.

autoDecisions.summary: Restore the credential refresh into a new module rather than remote-completion.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the restored code byte-for-byte reviewable and lets it run in parallel with the two reap items that edit remote-completion.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: The live smoke test asks operator consent at run time and runs pre-merge from the workspace build
autoDecisions.rationale: It spends Fly money, flips remote.enabled in the operator's global config (currently false) and opens a throwaway PR; those are the operator's call. The fallback tells the orchestrator and leaves the item pending. Only the Flywheel deploys (pan reload builds origin/main), so pre-merge evidence comes from `node dist/cli/index.js` in the workspace and the automatic 60 s tick is checked by a filed post-merge issue.

expected_outputs: remote-completion.test.ts passes all six WI-3 cases

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3, follow its decision table exactly. Add 'indeterminate' to RemoteReapResult.status. Replace listActiveRemoteAgents with listReapableRemoteAgents (status === 'running' only; an explicit opts.issueId still targets any state). Add private tri-state probes probeRemoteSession (has-session ... && echo exists || echo not-found) and probeDoneSentinel ('[ -f /workspace/.pan/REMOTE_DONE ] && echo present || echo absent') in remote-completion.ts using remote-tmux.js helpers: exitCode !== 0, a thrown error or an unexpected token = 'unknown'. Read Fly machine state first via fly.getStatus(vmName). running+sentinel yes -> existing hand-off path; running+session yes+sentinel no -> still-running after healStaleRemoteAuth; running+session no+sentinel no -> existing crash path; stopped -> crash path without probes and without the pane-capture contradiction guard, detail 'Fly reports <vm> stopped — treating as crash, not completion'; anything else (any unknown probe, or machine state creating/deleting/unknown) -> 'indeterminate' with a detail naming the indeterminate input, and NO salvage, stop or state write. Session probe retries up to 3 times 5 s apart only while 'unknown'. Stop importing isRemoteAgentRunning in this file (leave remote-agents.ts alone). reap.ts colours indeterminate yellow and does not count it as a failure. New test tests/lib/remote/remote-completion.test.ts with fake timers covering the six cases listed in WI-3 step 7.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-9. Implementation checkpoint, pre-merge. NEVER run pan reload or pan restart: only the Flywheel deploys, and pan reload builds origin/main, so the automatic 60 s tick cannot be observed before merge. After all other items are committed and pushed, ask the operator with a self-contained AskUserQuestion for consent (flip remote.enabled=true in ~/.overdeck/config.toml, throwaway issue 'Fly remote smoke test (PAN-4295)' whose task appends one line to docs/fly-smoke.txt, pan plan <id> --auto, pan start <id> --remote with the installed pan, a few cents of Fly spend, then close the throwaway PR unmerged, delete its branch and restore remote.enabled=false). If approved: npm run build in this workspace (local dist only), then collect O1 (no id_* / exe-dev-key under /root/.ssh or /.ssh on the VM), O2 (workspace-built `node dist/cli/index.js admin remote reap --issue <SMOKE-ID>` prints still-running mid-work and the machine stays started), O3 (after REMOTE_DONE, --dry-run prints handed-off, then the real run prints handed-off with 'Requested review through the dashboard review route', workspaces/feature-<smoke-id> exists and the machine is gone). The pre-merge journal source will be 'api' (deployed route is old) — expected. Record O1-O3 under a new 'Live verification' heading at the end of docs/fly-provider.md and in the PR body. File a GitHub issue 'Verify automatic Fly reap and heartbeat on the deployed build (PAN-4295 follow-up)' listing the post-merge checks from PRD WI-9 step 5 and link it. Decision rule: failures caused by this issue's code are fixed here; others are filed as new issues linking PAN-4295. Fallback: declined/unanswered/Fly unreachable -> leave pending, `pan tell flywheel-orchestrator "work PAN-4295: live Fly smoke test needs operator consent (Fly spend + remote.enabled) — everything else is done"`, record the blocker in continue.json.

items.title: Given the running smoke VM, when `fly ssh console -C "ls -la /root/.ssh /.ssh"` runs, then it shows no id_* file and no exe-dev-key (O1)

Given REMOTE_DONE exists on the VM, when the workspace-built reap runs without --dry-run, then it prints handed-off with 'Requested review through the dashboard review route', creates workspaces/feature-<smoke-id> locally and the machine no longer appears in `fly machines list` (O3)
Given O1-O3, when the item completes, then docs/fly-provider.md contains a 'Live verification' section with the date, smoke issue id, VM name, O1-O3 and a link to the filed post-merge check issue

Given the operator declines or does not answer, when the fallback runs, then the item stays pending, the agent sends the pan tell message to flywheel-orchestrator and continue.json records the blocker
